source: F. C. F. Alsubaei, Performance of protective perimeter walls subjected to explosions in reducing the blast resultants on buildings, Master's thesis, Western University, 2015, hdl:20.500.14721/35930
terms: Not stated by the repository. Derived numbers only: values transcribed from the thesis's tables and text, and a few read off its figures where noted; see README.md.

explosive.kind: ANFO in non-fragmenting cubic wooden boxes
explosive.tntFactorSource: Table 4.1 (pressure and impulse alike); Tables 7.2 and 8.2 give 125 kg as 102.5 kg TNT and 25 kg as 20.5 kg
explosive.halfScaleInitiation: top of the charge, 10-20 g PETN booster
explosive.fullScaleInitiation: centre of the charge, 0.4 kg pentolite booster
explosive.massesNote: Charge masses below are of ANFO, as the thesis gives them.

site.ground: reinforced concrete slab in front of the wall, a 20 mm steel plate under the charge: 'fully reflective'
site.wingWalls: concrete block (chapters 5-7) or reinforced concrete (chapter 8) wing walls each side of the wall 'to prevent the air blast pressure from wrapping around the wall'; their length is not stated
site.targets: galvanised steel pipe columns ('non-responding'), anchored to concrete foundations, standing for the building; diameter not stated
site.gauges: PCB 102B, 102B03, 102B04 piezoelectric gauges screwed onto the columns facing the charge, sampled at up to 100 kS/s; called reflected pressures
site.gaugesNote: The columns are narrow, so a gauge sees the reflected peak but the reflection clears in about a millisecond: the measured impulses are a quarter to a half of A.T.BLAST's for a building face (Tables 4.6-4.8, 4.12-4.14). Peaks are the usable measure.

wall.name: PWS (plane vertical wall, solid)
wall.bars: 10 mm at 200 mm both ways in both faces, 20 mm clear cover; 10 mm links at 200 mm; Grade 60, 420 MPa
wall.base: cast on bars projecting from a footing cast first; the footing set in a pit, backfilled and compacted; footing size not stated

noWall.note: Tables 4.3-4.5 and 4.9-4.11: peak reflected pressure on the columns with no wall, kPa, gauges P1-P4. Table 5.6 repeats the 14 kg row at 8.2 m.

behindPlaneWall.note: Tables 5.8-5.13, wall PWS: the adjustment factor, the measured peak (AFp) or impulse (AFi) behind the wall over that with no wall, gauges P1-P4; null where the thesis marks the gauge failed. The charges are 6.46 and 10 (10.05) kg.

halfScale.shots: Each wall took twelve successive shots rising from 0.45 to 14 kg (Table 5.4; scaled distances to the wall 2.79 to 0.89 m/kg^1/3 of TNT)
halfScale.damage: Plane walls with and without an opening: light shear cracking at the base of the front face at 0.86 m/kg^1/3 (the 14 kg shot), no significant deformation or local failure; 'Superficial' (ASCE 59-11). No deflection was measured.

halfScaleStreet.wall: as halfScale.wall, average cube strength 37 MPa

planeWallReductionAtP1.note: Legends of Figures 6.10-6.13: reduction of the peak at P1 (0.75 m) by the plane wall with the street level (WL-0.0), and with the street lowered 0.5 and 1.0 m in front of it. The plotted no-wall histories in those figures peak near 10, 20, 8 and 12 kPa, a seventh of the tables' values for the same shots; which is right is not stated.

halfScaleStreet.damage: No significant deformation or local failure in any test (up to 15.052 kg at 3 m, after twelve shots).

wall.name: T-RC-W (wall with a canopy)
wall.canopy: a flange 1.2 m wide (0.4 m beyond each face) and 0.4 m deep on top of the stem (Figure 7.2): top 2.4 m above the footing
wall.footing: 2.2 m wide (0.6 m and 1.2 m beyond the stem's faces; which way the longer heel faces is not stated) and 0.6 m deep, 12 mm bars at 100 mm; set in a backfilled pit (Figure 7.2)
wall.bars: 20 mm at 200 mm both ways in both faces, 40 mm clear cover; 10 mm links at 200 mm; 12 mm horizontal bars at 200 mm (Figure 7.2); Grade 60, 420 MPa
wall.base: cast on vertical bars projecting from the footing, cast first

fullScaleCanopied.noWallNote: Table 7.4. The lower two gauges' records were interrupted, so no impulses there.

behindWallPeak_kPa.note: Read off Figure 7.33 to about 2 kPa (the no-wall points read back within 2 kPa of Table 7.4). The walls differ only by aluminium foam panels (40 mm, 420 kg/m^3) on their faces; the unfaced control wall T-RC-W1 is not plotted.

midHeightDeflection_mm.note: Table 7.3: peak deflection at mid-height on the back (point A) from double-integrated accelerometer records, and the rotation the thesis takes from it (the arctangent over 0.8 m). Not given for the unfaced wall T-RC-W1. The plotted velocities reach 6-12 m/s within 4 ms and the displacements are still rising at the plots' end, so the integration probably drifts.

fullScaleCanopied.damage: T-RC-W1 (no foam): a crack along the full length at the foot of the front face, three horizontal flexural cracks across the full width of the back face at mid-height, no significant deformation or local failure; 'Superficial to Moderate'. Foam-faced walls: flexural cracks on the back only, minor.

wall.units: two leaves of 400 x 200 x 200 mm two-cell hollow concrete blocks, running bond, face-shell bedded on 10 mm mortar joints, head joints staggered between the leaves
wall.bars: a 20 mm vertical bar in the centre of every cell (200 mm apart in each leaf) and 12 mm horizontal joint reinforcement
wall.cells: filled with expanding polyurethane foam, 62 kg/m^3 free-rise; the text also calls the walls 'fully grouted'

fullScaleMasonry.gaugeHeights_m: four, on the column behind; heights not given in this chapter

shots.damage: Front: bed-joint cracks (bond lost) at courses 1, 4, 5, 6 and 10. Back: minor bed-joint cracks at courses 4-6; the top (10th) course offset sideways, an out-of-plane sliding shear failure. No spalling. 'Superficial to Moderate'.

shots.wall: unfaced (RMW-4-NP in Table 8.2, RMW-2-NP in the text)
shots.damage: Collapsed completely; debris found about 15 m away. 'Hazardous'.

fullScaleMasonry.deflectionNote: Table 8.3: top deflection from double-integrated accelerometer records (the mid-height accelerometer failed); rotation = arctan(deflection / 2 m). Each wall took one shot.
